name: Sheshach
title: Son of Makir from the tribe of Manasseh
summary: Sheshach was a son of Makir, who was a son of Manasseh. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the genealogy of the tribe of Manasseh. His brother Peresh also had sons who are listed in the genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the Genealogy of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: Sheshach is mentioned as a son of Makir, son of Manasseh, in the genealogy found in 1 Chronicles.

keyEvents.title: The Family and Descendants of Makir
keyEvents.description: Makir took a wife from Huppim and Shuppim, and his sister's name was Maacah. Sheshach was part of this family line.

keyEvents.title: The Inheritance of the Tribe of Manasseh
keyEvents.description: As part of the tribe of Manasseh, Sheshach was among those who received a share in the tribe's inheritance and land in the Promised Land.

keyEvents.title: Makir's Role as a Warrior
keyEvents.description: Shereesh's father Makir is described as a great warrior, and his descendants were given land in Gilead and Bashan.

keyEvents.title: Manasseh's Lineage through Makir
keyEvents.description: The lineage from Manasseh through Makir to Shereesh and his brother Perez is part of Israel's tribal record, showing God's faithfulness to the promises made to the patriarchs.
